title: RECAST: Model Reconstruction via Counterfactual-Aware Wasserstein Geometry under Limited Data

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring algorithmic disparities across racial groups by calculating Threshold Invariant Demographic Parity (TIDP) and Threshold Invariant Equalized Odds (TIEO) using Wasserstein-1 distance to compare score distributions, particularly evaluated on the COMPAS dataset.

Assessing group fairness and asymmetric treatment across gender using Wasserstein geometry-based adaptations of TIDP and TIEO to compare score distributions and evaluate if a reconstructed model preserves the target model's fairness characteristics.
